bias.en: Uptrend, momentum fading · holding above the 30-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势，动能减弱 · 守在 30 日均线上方

read.en: Palantir slipped 0.8% on Oct 20 to $192.60 on light volume, trading between $189.42 and $196.11. It is above the rising 30-day ($187.8), 100-day ($158.3) and 200-day ($152.9) averages and below the falling 5-day ($194.9) and rising 10-day ($199.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and is above zero with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($210.33), and RSI is 52.
read.zh: Palantir 10月20日下跌 0.8%，收于 $192.60，成交清淡，盘中区间 $189.42–196.11。股价位于上行的 30 日（$187.8）、100 日（$158.3）和 200 日均线（$152.9）上方，低于下行的 5 日（$194.9）和上行的 10 日均线（$199.4）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$210.33），RSI 为 52。

read.en: The close sat on the $192.6 Oct 15 low reclaimed on Oct 19, and the low held above the 30-day. Resistance is $194.9–196.1 (5-day, Oct 20 high), then $197–199.4 (Oct 19 high, 10-day), then $203.6. Support is $189.4 (Oct 20 low), then $187.8 (30-day) and $184.5 (Oct 16 low). A close above $199.4 would open $203.6; a close below $187.8 would open $184.5.
